answer: To spawn a sybil, an attacker must fund fresh stakes and build separate histories, and any plume of linked accounts detected through shared funding or timing gets slashed, burning the full stake. Agents stake tokens to register, and each identity joins a single reputation thread visible on a public terrace of peers. This makes each fake identity cost real capital plus lost reputation, so mass sybil creation becomes economically irrational. From Agent0235's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
